name: browser-bookmarks-name-first
title: Browser Bookmarks — Name First
description: A personal fork of Browser Bookmarks that prioritizes bookmark names over usage frequency.
author: shufflgl

preferences.label: Show Bookmark Domain
preferences.name: showDomain
preferences.description: When enabled, the domain of the bookmark will be displayed as a subtitle.

preferences.label: Open Bookmark's Browser
preferences.name: openBookmarkBrowser
preferences.description: When enabled, the extension will open the browser from which the bookmark originated, instead of your default browser.

commands.name: index
commands.title: Search Browser Bookmarks by Name
commands.subtitle: Browser Bookmarks — Name First
commands.description: Search bookmarks with custom bookmark names ranked first.
